Subject: Kelridge Realty Holdings - Quote in Progress

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Kelridge Realty Holdings! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have a few quick questions before I finalize terms:

- Can you confirm the primary occupancy type for each of the three locations?
- Are there any properties with flat roofs over 20 years old?
- Does the insured have any updated protective safeguards (sprinklers, alarms, etc.) beyond what's shown on the SOV?
- Any planned renovations or improvements in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for you. Targeting to have something back within 48 hours of receiving your responses.

Thanks!

[Underwriter name]
